comment.text: SLC4A11 V718 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Breast carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting SLC4A11 residue V718 have been observed in breast carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
